description: Department of Fisheries & Aquatic Resource - Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Act,No 2 Of 1996, (The Mud Crab Fishery Management Regulations 2024)
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Fisheries under the Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Act, No. 2 of 1996. It establishes new legal requirements and restrictions for mud crab fishing operations, including licensing requirements, size limitations, seasonal restrictions, and data reporting obligations. This fits the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) as it creates new regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements under existing legislation.
